_doc: Copy to ~/.healthapp-dashboard/directions.json (install.sh does it once and never overwrites it). One entry per direction of the project goal. Change `status` (on_track | at_risk | off_track | not_started), `note` (one line, at most 300 characters) and `updatedAt` (ISO time with offset) by hand; the next snapshot run (every 3 minutes) carries it. Summary text only: no patient data, no exam content, no keys. A missing file means the dashboard says 'not reported yet'; a typo leaves the panel empty and shows the reason in the hand block's error.

directions.title: Store + analyse original files (staging and main)
